title: Annapurna Base Camp
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Annapurna Base Camp (ABC) passing through terraced fields, rhododendron forests and traditional Gurung villages. Most popular and scenic trekking routes.
highlights: ️ Spectacular views of Annapurna massif and Machhapuchhre (Fishtail) 🌸 Rhododendron forests and diverse flora 🏕️ Stay at Annapurna Base Camp surrounded by towering peaks 🏘️ Traditional Gurung and Magar villages 🌅 Stunning sunrises and sunsets over the Himalayas 🌿 Well-established and popular trekking route

title: Tsho-Rolpa Lake
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Tsho Rolpa is one of Nepals largest glacial lakes formed by the melting Trakarding Glacier and is known for its turquoise waters and risk of glacial outburst floods.
highlights: One of Nepal’s largest glacial lakes formed from the melt of the Trakarding and Drolambu glaciers. 🏔️ Nestled between the Gaurishankar and Rolwaling Himal ranges, offering dramatic alpine scenery. 🔭 Panoramic views of towering peaks like Gaurishankar (7,134m), Melungtse (7,181m) and Rolwaling peaks. 🕉️ Rich cultural encounters with Sherpa and Tamang communities in Simigaun, Beding and Na. 🏕️ Camping experience at the lake — perfect for adventurous trekkers. 🐐 Wildlife sightings possible: musk deer, Himalayan tahr, langur monkeys and mountain birds. ❄️ Spectacular glacier views and icy waters with turquoise color on sunny days

title: Annapurna Circuit
best_months: Autumn: September- December Spring : February-May
overview: The Annapurna Circuit passes through diverse landscapes-from lush subtropical valleys to high alpine terrain-crossing the Thorong La Pass along with rich cultural experiences.
highlights: Thorong La Pass (5,416m): One of the highest trekking passes in the world. 🌄 Breathtaking Views: Annapurna, Dhaulagiri, Machhapuchhre, Manaslu. 🏡 Cultural Villages: Experience Gurung, Thakali and Manangi lifestyles. 🛕 Spiritual Sites: Visit Muktinath Temple and Buddhist monasteries. 💦 Hot Springs: Relax at Tatopani’s natural hot spring. 🏞️ Varied Landscapes: Lush valleys to high-altitude deserts.

title: Manaslu Base Camp
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Manaslu Base Camp is the starting point for climbs of Mount Manaslu worlds eighth-highest peak.
highlights: ️ Manaslu Base Camp at 4,800 m with views of glaciers and the 8th highest peak (Mt. Manaslu – 8,163 m) 🏞️ Larkya La Pass (5,160 m) – a breathtaking and challenging crossing 🧘‍♀️ Authentic Tibetan Buddhist culture in Samagaon and Samdo 🐂 Encounters with yaks, mani walls, and traditional mountain villages 🧭 Remote & peaceful alternative to Annapurna or Everest regions 🌳 Rich biodiversity from tropical forests to alpine deserts 🚶‍♂️ Less crowded trails + a feeling of true wilderness

title: Lantang Valley Trek
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: The Langtang Valley Trek leads you through lush forests, Tamang villages and alpine meadows up to Kyanjin Gompa along with rich Tibetan-influenced culture.
highlights: ️ Close-up views of Langtang Lirung (7,227 m) 🌄 Spectacular sunrise from Tserko Ri (4,984 m) 🧘‍♂️ Visit to Kyanjin Gompa monastery and local cheese factory 🌲 Trek through lush forests, bamboo groves, and waterfalls 🐂 Encounter yaks, red pandas, and Himalayan birds 🏡 Rich Tamang Buddhist culture and warm hospitality 🛕 Easily accessible from Kathmandu (no flights needed)

title: Mardi Himal Base Camp
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Mardi Himal Base Camp leading through rhododendron forests, ridgelines, and high pastures with spectacular views of Machapuchare [Fishtail], Annapurna South and Hiunchuli.
highlights: Close-Up Views: Mardi Himal, Machhapuchhre (Fishtail), Annapurna South, and Hiunchuli 🌲 Diverse Trails: Lush forests, alpine meadows, and dramatic ridgelines 🌄 Spectacular Sunrise/Sunset: From High Camp and Viewpoints 🏡 Local Culture: Gurung and Magar hospitality in traditional villages 📷 Photogenic Landscapes 🚶 Short & Sweet: Can be completed in 4–6 days

title: Shey-Phoksundo Lake
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Shey Phoksundo Lake is Nepals deepest and second-largest lake with stunning turquoise-blue water surrounded by dramatic cliffs and alpine scenery.
highlights: Stunning turquoise Shey Phoksundo Lake 🌊 Nepal’s tallest Phoksundo Waterfall 🕉️ Traditional Bon Buddhist villages (Ringmo) ✈️ Scenic mountain flights Kathmandu–Juphal 🐐 Wildlife & pristine national park nature 🌿 Off-the-beaten-path, peaceful trekking

title: Makalu Base Camp
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Makalu Base Camp serves as the starting point for expeditions to Makalu, the worlds fifth-highest mountain. Remote and less crowded
highlights: ️ Close-up views of Mt. Makalu (8,481 m) – 5th highest peak 🌳 Trek through Makalu-Barun National Park – rich in biodiversity 🕉️ Remote Sherpa villages & Tibetan Buddhist culture 🐾 Chance to spot red panda, Himalayan tahr 🚫 Off-the-beaten-path wilderness experience 🌄 Stunning alpine lakes, glaciers, and ridgelines

title: Everest Base Camp
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Everest Base Camp serves as the starting point for expeditions to Everest, the worlds highest mountain.
highlights: ️ Base Camp of the world’s highest peak(5,364m) – Mt. Everest (8,848.86 m) 🧭 Iconic viewpoint at Kala Patthar (5,545 m) for sunrise views 🕉️ Tengboche Monastery – spiritual heart of the Khumbu 🦅 Namche Bazaar the bustling Sherpa capital and Incredible Himalayan scenery ✈️ Thrilling Lukla flight experience an exhilarating landing at one of the world’s most dramatic airports. ❄️ Glaciers, icefalls, suspension bridges, and yak trains

title: Gosaikunda Lake
best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Gosaikunda Lake is a high-altitude alpine lake located at 4,380 meters in Nepal's Langtang region. Surrounded by rugged peaks and rich mythology. It is a sacred site for both Hindus and Buddhists. The trek to Gosaikunda offers stunning landscapes, cultural encounters, and a sense of spiritual tranquility.
highlights: Holy alpine lake 🕉️ Important pilgrimage site during Janai Purnima festival 🏞️ Langtang Himal views, rocky trails and high passes (Laurebina La) 🌺 Rhododendron forests, yak pastures and mountain ridges 🐐 Tamang villages and Buddhist culture 🌄 Peaceful, less-crowded trekking experience

highlights: Highest trekking peak in Nepal Everest, Makalu, Lhotse views Trekking + climbing experience

best_months: March to May September to November
overview: Kathmandu → Bhadrapur/Birtamod → Taplejung → Sekathum → Amjilosa → Ghunsa → Kambachen → Lhonak → Pangpema (North Base Camp) → Sele La Pass → Cheram → Oktang (South Base Camp) → Yamphudin → Taplejung
highlights: Third-highest mountain in the world Both North & South Base Camps Remote and wilderness experience

highlights: Three high mountain passes Combines EBC + Gokyo Advanced trekking experience

highlights: Where sacred lakes meet yak pastures , Sherpa culture and quiet face of Numburchuli.
